Trump fordert nach Dieseldeal mit Putin Selenskyjs Ablösung Am Freitag hatte US-Präsident Trump einen Dieseldeal mit Russland angekündigt. Die Ukraine reagierte empört, nun fordert Trump eine Ablösung des ukrainischen Staatschefs Selenskyj. Er habe die Schuld an den hohen Energiepreisen.

title: Palestinian President Abbas postpones legislative elections until September 2027
summary:
Palestinian President Abbas postpones legislative elections until September 2027 On Friday, Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar accused Abbas of "fooling the international community by canceling once again promised elections" as rumours of the postponement circulated.
Palestinian president Abbas postpones legislative, presidential elections to September 2027 ⁠⁠Palestinian president ​Mahmoud ​Abbas announced on Saturday that legislative ⁠elections would be postponed from November ​28 to September ​11, 2027, the ​official Palestinian news agency ⁠WAFA reported. In his presidential decree, Abbas set the next presidential elections for that day as well.
